mechanism.rule: A two-level dispatch: an object field holds a pointer to a static table from a finite declared cohort; the indirect call selects a member at a fixed offset; every cohort store must be a declared table address, every selected member must be an in-image function start, the table must be immutable after relocation, and the writer set must be complete.
mechanism.field_sensitivity: keyed by (object type, pointer-slot offset, member offset), never by offset alone; the DSO has 98,005 offset-keyed stores over 1,709 offsets, so an offset-keyed completeness claim is impossible
mechanism.via_cast: when the field's declared type has no decidable member at the call offset, a .cast::<T>() applied to that field in the same source function is accepted only if T has a decidable repr(C) layout and declared static instances in the exact image
